mentions.name: Vox Labs
mentions.description: AI-powered outbound sales platform where users direct it like an SDR: given guidance, it handles prospect research, enrichment, personalization, and outbound sequencing, with an agent orchestration layer (Claude) managing multi-step workflows with judgment and state management.
mentions.audience: founders, small sales teams, and agencies
mentions.source_excerpt: Building Vox Labs, an AI-powered outbound sales platform for founders, small sales teams, and agencies. The idea is you work with it the way you'd direct an SDR: give it guidance and it handles research, enrichment, personalization, and sequencing.
